bluetooth.title: Connect a radio through Bluetooth
bluetooth.description: Use a local adapter or Bluetooth proxy. Close other apps holding the radio. Nearby radios: {discovered}

server.title: Connect to MeshCore Sender
server.description: Start the MeshCore server App and set up its passphrase in its web interface first.

error.invalid_address: Enter a Bluetooth MAC address, such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.cannot_connect_bluetooth: Radio connection failed. Power on the radio near a proxy and close other connected apps.
error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS server URL without a path or credentials.
error.invalid_auth: Check the server passphrase and complete server setup first.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to MeshCore Sender. Check the URL and that the App is running.
